ns2:course.label: Counterpoint and Fugue
ns2:course.description: Study of contrapuntal writing, including fugue, with emphasis on the works of J.S. Bach. Includes analysis of contrapuntal writing. Prerequisite: MUS 202 and MUS 208, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 202 and MUS 208, or consent of instructor.
